_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. aboard.com is a WordPress theme that declares about 640 custom properties (raw/css-vars.json): the --wp--preset--* palette/spacing presets and the --rd-* design tokens. A leaf either names a variable ("var") whose value is the browser-resolved one in css-vars.json, or carries a measured "value" with the measurement it came from in "source" (a component/state of raw/measurements.md). One theme: the marketing site paints a single light scheme — warm off-white pages with warm-black and ink text, a bright-citrus accent — plus dark footer/podcast bands inside the same paint.
